title: dotbabel local-attest evidence payload
description: Line 2 of a local-attest comment, base64url-encoded. The merge gate reads this to decide whether the attested run may stand in for re-running the full suite and the PR quality profile.

head_sha.description: The commit the matrix ran against. Must equal the SHA in the marker on line 1; the gate refuses a payload that disagrees with its own marker.

merge_base.description: The merge base the quality profile graded its diff against. Recorded because the quality verdict is a property of a diff, not of a tree.

config_hash.description: Hash of the files that govern what this run proves. The gate recomputes it from the BASE ref, so a pull request that edits a governed file cannot attest itself.

legs.description: One entry per matrix leg, classified by the same legStatus() the comment table and the audit log use.

toolchain.description: The versions this run certified. An attestation can switch off a multi-version CI matrix, so the record names the one version it covered.
